consequence.statement: This is an additive feature that enables new customization capability for Venafi client authentication; existing configurations remain unchanged

original.statement: Added the ability to customize client ID when using username/password authentication for Venafi client.

decision.reason: [ev-fe02a4220985] lists this only as a Feature that "Added the ability to customize client ID" for Venafi username/password authentication. That describes a new optional capability and says nothing about a changed default, a removed setting, or anything failing or being rejected. So "none" (informational) is the supported consequence. The claim that existing configurations stay the same is implied by the opt-in wording, not stated outright.
